definition: First visually observable engine-base glow, bright core, or ignition-induced local illumination. Do not wait for exposed liftoff plume or rocket motion.
label_type: single-reviewer visual annotation, not engine telemetry; clear pre-glow and first definite glow frames bracket a 0.1-0.2s visual uncertainty range
use: Offline evaluation only; never passed to detector or used to arm monitoring.
